title: Shesha-khanda, part 3 (portion 48)
html:
The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana" (continued): Krishnadasa shows the Lord Mathura — the walls, Kamsa's palace, the prison, the "place where He passed water" as an infant, Uddhava's house, the twelve ghats, Kamsa's well; the story of the Setubandha lake; the places of Krishna's infant and childhood lilas in Mahavana and Gokula; Nanda entrusts the Child to Radha in Bilvavana; the cowherds move to Vrindavana; the places of Krishna's sports with the cowherd boys — the Lord in the mood of a friend

এইমতে কথালাপে প্রভাত হইল ।
যে বিধি আছিল প্রভু প্রাতঃক্রিয়া কৈল ॥ ৮৫ ॥

eimate kathālāpe prabhāta haila |
ye bidhi āchila prabhu prātaḥkriẏā kaila || 85 ||

eimate — thus; kathalape — in conversation; prabhata haila — morning came; ye vidhi achhila — as prescribed; prabhu pratah-kriya kaila — the Lord performed the morning rites

85Thus in conversation the morning came;
the Lord performed His morning rites as prescribed.

উৎকণ্ঠা-হৃদয়ে দিল কৃষ্ণদাসে ডাক ।
দেহকে জিনিঞা সে অধিক অনুরাগ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

utkaṇṭhā-hṛdaẏe dila kṛṣṇadāse ḍāka |
dehake jiniñā se adhika anurāga || 86 ||

utkantha-hridaye — with a longing heart; dila krishnadase daka — called Krishnadasa; dehake jininya — surpassing the body; se adhika anuraga — that love was greater

86With a longing heart He called Krishnadasa;
His love was more than His body could hold.

দেখিতে চলিলা প্রভু মথুরামণ্ডল ।
আপনে ঈশ্বর কৃষ্ণদাসে করে ছল ॥ ৮৭ ॥

dekhite calilā prabhu mathurāmaṇḍala |
āpane īśbara kṛṣṇadāse kare chala || 87 ||

dekhite chalila prabhu — the Lord set out to see; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; apane ishvara — Ishvara Himself; krishnadase kare chhala — plays a prank on Krishnadasa

87The Lord set out to see the Mathura-mandala;
Ishvara Himself plays a prank on Krishnadasa1.

কৃষ্ণদাস কহে প্রভু ইথে কর মন ।
পুরীর তিনদিগে দেখ গড়ের পত্তন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

kṛṣṇadāsa kahe prabhu ithe kara mana |
purīra tinadige dekha gaṛera pattana || 88 ||

krishnadasa kahe — Krishnadasa says; prabhu ithe kara mana — Lord, turn Your mind here; purira tinadige — on three sides of the city; dekha gadera pattana — see the fortifications

88Krishnadasa says: "Lord, turn Your mind here:
see, on three sides of the city — the fortifications.

পূরবে যমুনা নদী বহে দক্ষিণমুখে ।
উত্তর-দক্ষিণ-দ্বার গড়ের দুইদিগে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

pūrabe yamunā nadī bahe dakṣiṇamukhe |
uttara-dakṣiṇa-dbāra gaṛera duidige || 89 ||

purabe — on the east; yamuna nadi bahe dakshina-mukhe — the river Yamuna flows southward; uttara-dakshina-dvara — north and south gates; gadera duidige — on two sides of the fort

89On the east the river Yamuna flows southward;
on two sides of the fortifications are the north and south gates.

কংসের আবাস দেখ পুরীর নৈঋতে ।
পূরবে উত্তরে দুই দুয়ার তাহাতে ॥ ৯০ ॥

kaṃsera ābāsa dekha purīra naiṛte |
pūrabe uttare dui duẏāra tāhāte || 90 ||

kamsera avasa dekha — see Kamsa's palace; purira nairite — south-west of the city; purabe uttare — to east and north; dui duyara tahate — two gates in it

90See here Kamsa's palace — south-west of the city;
it has two gates, to the east and to the north.

বসিবার চৌতারা দেখ বাড়ীর উত্তর ।
পুরীর বায়ুকোণে দেখ হের কারাগার ॥ ৯১ ॥

basibāra cautārā dekha bāṛīra uttara |
purīra bāẏukoṇe dekha hera kārāgāra || 91 ||

basibara chautara — a platform for sitting; dekha badira uttara — see, north of the palace; purira vayu-kone — in the north-west of the city; dekha hera karagara — see, here is the prison

91See — north of the palace a platform for sitting;
and here, see, in the north-west of the city — the prison.

মূত্রস্থান হের দেখ ইহার দক্ষিণে ।
বিবরি' কহিব কিছু শুন সাবধানে ॥ ৯২ ॥

mūtrasthāna hera dekha ihāra dakṣiṇe |
bibari' kahiba kichu śuna sābadhāne || 92 ||

mutra-sthana hera dekha — here, see, the "place where He passed water"; ihara dakshine — south of it; vivari kahiba kichhu — I will tell something in detail; shuna savadhane — listen attentively

92And here, see, south of it — the 'place where He passed water';
I will tell about it in detail — listen attentively.

কংসভয়ে বসুদেব লঞা যায় পুত্র ।
আচম্বিতে কৃষ্ণ তার কোলে কৈল মূত্র ॥ ৯৩ ॥

kaṃsabhaẏe basudeba lañā yāẏa putra |
ācambite kṛṣṇa tāra kole kaila mūtra || 93 ||

kamsa-bhaye — in fear of Kamsa; vasudeva lanya yaya putra — Vasudeva carries away his son; achambite — suddenly; krishna tara kole kaila mutra — Krishna passed water in his arms

93In fear of Kamsa, Vasudeva carries away his son;
suddenly Krishna passed water in his arms.

এইখানে বসুদেব বসিলা সত্বর ।
প্রস্রাব করিলা কৃষ্ণ দ্রবিল পাথর ॥ ৯৪ ॥

eikhāne basudeba basilā satbara |
prasrāba karilā kṛṣṇa drabila pāthara || 94 ||

eikhane — here; vasudeva basila satvara — Vasudeva quickly sat down; prasrava karila krishna — Krishna passed water; dravila pathara — the stone melted

94Here Vasudeva quickly sat down;
Krishna passed water — and the stone melted.

মূত্রচিহ্ন রহিল এ পাষাণ-উপরে ।
মূত্রস্থান তেঞি লোক বোলয়ে ইহারে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

mūtracihna rahila e pāṣāṇa-upare |
mūtrasthāna teñi loka bolaẏe ihāre || 95 ||

mutra-chihna rahila — the mark of the water remained; e pashana-upare — on this stone; mutra-sthana — "the place where He passed water"; tenyi loka bolaye ihare — therefore people call it

95The mark of the water remained on this stone;
therefore people call this place the 'place where He passed water'2.

ইহার উত্তরে দেখ উদ্ধবের ঘর ।
এ বোল শুনিতে প্রভুর গলে দুই ধার ॥ ৯৬ ॥

ihāra uttare dekha uddhabera ghara |
e bola śunite prabhura gale dui dhāra || 96 ||

ihara uttare — north of here; dekha uddhavera ghara — see Uddhava's house; e bola shunite — on hearing this; prabhura gale dui dhara — two streams down the Lord's throat

96North of here, see, is Uddhava's house."
Hearing this, the Lord's tears ran in two streams down His throat.

কণ্টকিত ভেল অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
কদম্বকেশর জিনি' একটি পুলক ॥ ৯৭ ॥

kaṇṭakita bhela aṅga āpāda-mastaka |
kadambakeśara jini' ekaṭi pulaka || 97 ||

kantakita bhela anga — the body bristled; apada-mastaka — from foot to head; kadamba-keshara jini — like a kadamba filament; ekati pulaka — each thrilled hair

97His whole body from head to foot thrilled:
each hair stood up like a kadamba filament.

এই উদ্ধবের ঘর মুঞি আইলুঁ এবে ।
এথা যে করিল কৃষ্ণ কহোঁ অনুভবে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

ei uddhabera ghara muñi āiluṁ ebe |
ethā ye karila kṛṣṇa kahoṁ anubhabe || 98 ||

ei uddhavera ghara — here is Uddhava's house; munyi ailun ebe — I have come now; etha ye karila krishna — what Krishna did here; kahon anubhave — I tell from experience

98"Here is Uddhava's house — I have come here now;
what Krishna did here I tell from My own experience.

এইখানে কৃষ্ণ আর উদ্ধবের কথা ।
দেখিয়াছি যেন বাসোঁ মনে লাগে ব্যথা ॥ ৯৯ ॥

eikhāne kṛṣṇa āra uddhabera kathā |
dekhiẏāchi yena bāsoṁ mane lāge byathā || 99 ||

eikhane — here; krishna ara uddhavera katha — the talk of Krishna and Uddhava; dekhiyachhi yena bason — I feel as if I saw it; mane lage vyatha — pain strikes the heart

99Here took place the talk of Krishna and Uddhava;
I feel as if I saw it — and pain pierces My heart"3.

এ বোল বলিতে প্রভু চাহে চারিদিগে ।
তবে কহে কৃষ্ণদাস কহে অনুরাগে ॥ ১০০ ॥

e bola balite prabhu cāhe cāridige |
tabe kahe kṛṣṇadāsa kahe anurāge || 100 ||

e bola balite — saying this; prabhu chahe charidige — the Lord looks around; tabe kahe krishnadasa — then Krishnadasa speaks; kahe anurage — speaks with love

100Saying this, the Lord looks all around;
then, with love, Krishnadasa speaks:

উদ্ধবের পূর্বে দেখ রজকের ঘর ।
মালাকার-বাস দেখ পূরবে ইহার ॥ ১০১ ॥

uddhabera pūrbe dekha rajakera ghara |
mālākāra-bāsa dekha pūrabe ihāra || 101 ||

uddhavera purve — east of Uddhava's; dekha rajakera ghara — see the washerman's house; malakara-vasa dekha — see the garland-maker's dwelling; purabe ihara — east of it

101"East of Uddhava's [house], see, is the washerman's house;
and east of it, see, the dwelling of the garland-maker.

ইহার দক্ষিণে দেখ কুবুজীর ঘর ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে রঙ্গস্থান মনোহর ॥ ১০২ ॥

ihāra dakṣiṇe dekha kubujīra ghara |
tāhāra dakṣiṇe raṅgasthāna manohara || 102 ||

ihara dakshine — south of here; dekha kubujira ghara — see Kubja's house; tahara dakshine — south of it; ranga-sthana manohara — the lovely arena

102South of here, see, is Kubja's house;
south of it — the lovely arena.

বসুদেব-আবাস দেখ তার অগ্নিকোণে ।
এ বোল শুনিতে প্রভু হাসে মনে মনে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

basudeba-ābāsa dekha tāra agnikoṇe |
e bola śunite prabhu hāse mane mane || 103 ||

vasudeva-avasa dekha — see Vasudeva's house; tara agni-kone — south-east of it; e bola shunite — hearing this; prabhu hase mane mane — the Lord smiles within

103See — south-east of it is Vasudeva's house."
Hearing this, the Lord smiles within Himself,

গদগদ স্বর কিছু অরুণ বদন ।
উগ্রসেন-বাড়ী দেখ তাহার ঈশান ॥ ১০৪ ॥

gadagada sbara kichu aruṇa badana |
ugrasena-bāṛī dekha tāhāra īśāna || 104 ||

gadagada svara — the voice faltering; kichhu aruna vadana — the face somewhat flushed; ugrasena-badi dekha — see Ugrasena's house; tahara ishana — north-east of it

104His voice falters, His face flushes a little.
"See — north-east of it is Ugrasena's house.

দেখহ বিশ্রান্তিঘাট দক্ষিণে তাহার ।
গতশ্রম নাম মূর্তি এথা পরচার ॥ ১০৫ ॥

dekhaha biśrāntighāṭa dakṣiṇe tāhāra |
gataśrama nāma mūrti ethā paracāra || 105 ||

dekhaha vishranti-ghata — see the Vishranti-ghata; dakshine tahara — south of it; gatashrama nama murti — the Deity named Gatashrama; etha parachara — renowned here

105See — south of it is the Vishranti-ghata;
here the Deity named Gatashrama is renowned4.

কংস মারি' টানিঞা ফেলিতে হৈল খাল ।
তেঞি কংসখালি ঘাট দক্ষিণে তাহার ॥ ১০৬ ॥

kaṃsa māri' ṭāniñā phelite haila khāla |
teñi kaṃsakhāli ghāṭa dakṣiṇe tāhāra || 106 ||

kamsa mari — having killed Kamsa; taninya phelite — in dragging him away; haila khala — a channel was formed; tenyi kamsa-khali ghata — hence the Kamsa-khali ghata; dakshine tahara — south of it

106When Krishna killed Kamsa and dragged him away, a channel was formed —
therefore south of here is the Kamsa-khali ghata.

দেখহ প্রয়াগঘাট তাহার দক্ষিণে ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে ঘাট এ তিন্দুক নামে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

dekhaha praẏāgaghāṭa tāhāra dakṣiṇe |
tāhāra dakṣiṇe ghāṭa e tinduka nāme || 107 ||

dekhaha prayaga-ghata — see the Prayaga-ghata; tahara dakshine — south of it; tahara dakshine ghata — south of it a ghata; e tinduka name — named Tinduka

107See — south of it is the Prayaga-ghata;
south of it — the ghata named Tinduka.

সপ্ততীর্থ বলি' ঘাট ইহার দক্ষিণে ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে দেখ ঋষিতীর্থ নামে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

saptatīrtha bali' ghāṭa ihāra dakṣiṇe |
tāhāra dakṣiṇe dekha ṛṣitīrtha nāme || 108 ||

sapta-tirtha bali ghata — the ghata called Saptatirtha; ihara dakshine — south of here; tahara dakshine dekha — south of it see; rishitirtha name — the one named Rishitirtha

108South of here is the ghata called Saptatirtha;
south of it, see, [the ghata] named Rishitirtha.

ইহার দক্ষিণে দেখ মোক্ষতীর্থ আর ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে কোটিতীর্থের প্রচার ॥ ১০৯ ॥

ihāra dakṣiṇe dekha mokṣatīrtha āra |
tāhāra dakṣiṇe koṭitīrthera pracāra || 109 ||

ihara dakshine dekha — south of here see; moksha-tirtha ara — also Mokshatirtha; tahara dakshine — south of it; koti-tirthera prachara — the renowned Kotitirtha

109South of here, see, is also Mokshatirtha;
south of it — the renowned Kotitirtha.

তাহার দক্ষিণে দেখ বোধিতীর্থ নামে ।
দক্ষিণে গণেশতীর্থ দেখ বিদ্যমানে ॥ ১১০ ॥

tāhāra dakṣiṇe dekha bodhitīrtha nāme |
dakṣiṇe gaṇeśatīrtha dekha bidyamāne || 110 ||

tahara dakshine dekha — south of it see; bodhi-tirtha name — the one named Bodhitirtha; dakshine ganesha-tirtha — to the south Ganeshatirtha; dekha vidyamane — see, there it is

110South of it, see, [the ghata] named Bodhitirtha;
to the south — Ganeshatirtha, there it is, see.

এই ত দ্বাদশ ঘাট সর্বতীর্থ-সার ।
পুরীর দক্ষিণে রঙ্গভূমি দেখ আর ॥ ১১১ ॥

ei ta dbādaśa ghāṭa sarbatīrtha-sāra |
purīra dakṣiṇe raṅgabhūmi dekha āra || 111 ||

ei ta dvadasha ghata — these are the twelve ghatas; sarva-tirtha-sara — the essence of all holy places; purira dakshine — south of the city; ranga-bhumi dekha ara — see also the arena

111These are the twelve ghatas — the essence of all holy places.
And south of the city, see, there is also the arena.

তাহার দক্ষিণে আর দেখ অপরূপ ।
দুরাশয় কংসরাজা খুদিলেক কূপ ॥ ১১২ ॥

tāhāra dakṣiṇe āra dekha aparūpa |
durāśaẏa kaṃsarājā khudileka kūpa || 112 ||

tahara dakshine — south of it; ara dekha aparupa — see another marvel; durashaya kamsaraja — the evil-minded King Kamsa; khudileka kupa — dug a well

112South of it, see, is one more marvel:
the evil-minded King Kamsa dug a well.

কৃষ্ণ মারি' ইহাতে ফেলিব এই কাম ।
কংস খনিল কূপ কংসকূপ নাম ॥ ১১৩ ॥

kṛṣṇa māri' ihāte pheliba ei kāma |
kaṃsa khanila kūpa kaṃsakūpa nāma || 113 ||

krishna mari — having killed Krishna; ihate pheliba — I will throw [Him] in here; ei kama — this was the plan; kamsa khanila kupa — Kamsa dug the well; kamsa-kupa nama — the name Kamsa-kupa

113'Having killed Krishna, I will throw Him in here' — such was his plan;
Kamsa dug the well — [hence] the name Kamsa-kupa.

দেখহ অগস্ত্যকুণ্ড নৈঋতে তাহার ।
সেতুবন্ধ-সরোবর উত্তরে ইহার ॥ ১১৪ ॥

dekhaha agastyakuṇḍa naiṛte tāhāra |
setubandha-sarobara uttare ihāra || 114 ||

dekhaha agastya-kunda — see the Agastya-kunda; nairite tahara — south-west of it; setubandha-sarovara — the Setubandha lake; uttare ihara — north of here

114See — south-west of it is the Agastya-kunda;
north of here — the Setubandha lake."

এ বোল শুনিতে প্রভু কি কি বলি' ডাকে ।
অঙ্গ আচ্ছাদিল ঘন অঙ্গের পুলকে ॥ ১১৫ ॥

e bola śunite prabhu ki ki bali' ḍāke |
aṅga ācchādila ghana aṅgera pulake || 115 ||

e bola shunite — hearing this; prabhu ki ki bali dake — the Lord cries "What? What?"; anga achchhadila — the body was covered; ghana angera pulake — with dense thrill

115Hearing this, the Lord cries: "What? What?" —
and His body was covered all over with thrill.

সেতুবন্ধ-সরোবরের শুন বিবরণ ।
সাবধানে শুন প্রভু হঞা একমন ॥ ১১৬ ॥

setubandha-sarobarera śuna bibaraṇa |
sābadhāne śuna prabhu hañā ekamana || 116 ||

setubandha-sarovarera — of the Setubandha lake; shuna vivarana — hear the account; savadhane shuna prabhu — listen attentively, Lord; hanya ekamana — with a collected mind

116"Hear the account of the Setubandha lake;
listen attentively, Lord, with a collected mind.

এককালে আছে কৃষ্ণ গোপীগণ-মেলে ।
রাসক্রীড়া করে এই সরোবর-কূলে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

ekakāle āche kṛṣṇa gopīgaṇa-mele |
rāsakrīṛā kare ei sarobara-kūle || 117 ||

ekakale — once; achhe krishna — Krishna was; gopigana-mele — in the company of the gopis; rasa-krida kare — plays the rasa dance; ei sarovara-kule — on the bank of this lake

117Once Krishna, in the company of the gopis,
was playing the rasa dance on the bank of this lake.

রাধাকে কহিল আমি সেই রঘুনাথ ।
রাবণ মারিল আমি বানরের সাথ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

rādhāke kahila āmi sei raghunātha |
rābaṇa mārila āmi bānarera sātha || 118 ||

radhake kahila — He said to Radha; ami sei raghunatha — I am that Raghunatha; ravana marila ami — I killed Ravana; vanarera satha — together with the monkeys

118He said to Radha: 'I am that very Raghunatha:
I killed Ravana together with the monkeys.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাধা মুচকি হাসয় ।
মিছা কথা কহে কৃষ্ণ এই ত আশয় ॥ ১১৯ ॥

e bola śuniñā rādhā mucaki hāsaẏa |
michā kathā kahe kṛṣṇa ei ta āśaẏa || 119 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; radha muchaki hasaya — Radha smiles faintly; michha katha kahe krishna — Krishna tells an untruth; ei ta ashaya — this is the thought

119Hearing this, Radha smiled faintly:
'Krishna is telling an untruth — that is what is on [His] mind.'

দেখিয়া তরস্ত হঞা পুছয়ে রাধারে ।
কি লাগিয়া হাস রাই বোলহ আমারে ॥ ১২০ ॥

dekhiẏā tarasta hañā puchaẏe rādhāre |
ki lāgiẏā hāsa rāi bolaha āmāre || 120 ||

dekhiya — seeing; tarasta hanya — perturbed; puchhaye radhare — asks Radha; ki lagiya hasa rai — why do you laugh, Rai; bolaha amare — tell Me

120Seeing this, He, perturbed, asks Radha:
'Why do you laugh, Rai? Tell Me!'

রাধা বোলে মিছা কথা না বলিহ আর ।
তুমি সে কেমনে হৈলে রাম-অবতার ॥ ১২১ ॥

rādhā bole michā kathā nā baliha āra |
tumi se kemane haile rāma-abatāra || 121 ||

radha bole — Radha says; michha katha na baliha ara — tell no more untruths; tumi se kemane haile — how did You become; rama-avatara — the avatara Rama

121Radha says: 'Tell no more untruths!
How could You have been the avatara Rama?

মহাজিতেন্দ্রিয় তেঁহো পরম ঈশ্বর ।
তোমাতে সম্ভবে নাহি তাঁর ব্যবহার ॥ ১২২ ॥

mahājitendriẏa teṁho parama īśbara |
tomāte sambhabe nāhi tāṁra byabahāra || 122 ||

maha-jitendriya tenho — He is a great master of the senses; parama ishvara — the Supreme Ishvara; tomate sambhave nahi — is not possible in You; tanra vyavahara — His conduct

122He is a great master of the senses, the Supreme Ishvara;
His conduct is not possible for You.

সমুদ্র বান্ধিলা তেঁহো এ গাছ-পাথরে ।
তুমিহ বান্ধহ দেখি এই সরোবরে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

samudra bāndhilā teṁho e gācha-pāthare |
tumiha bāndhaha dekhi ei sarobare || 123 ||

samudra bandhila tenho — He dammed the ocean; e gachha-pathare — with these trees and stones; tumiha bandhaha dekhi — let us see You too dam; ei sarovare — this lake

123He dammed the ocean with trees and stones —
let us see You dam this lake!'

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু লহু লহু হাসে ।
আমি জলে থুইলে সে ইটা-পাথর ভাসে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu lahu lahu hāse |
āmi jale thuile se iṭā-pāthara bhāse || 124 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu lahu lahu hase — the Lord (Krishna) smiles gently; ami jale thuile — if I place in the water; se ita-pathara bhase — bricks and stones float

124Hearing this, [Krishna] smiles gently:
'If I place bricks and stones in the water, they will float.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা গোপী বলিছে বচন ।
আনিয়ে পাথর দেখি বান্ধহ এখন ॥ ১২৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā gopī baliche bacana |
āniẏe pāthara dekhi bāndhaha ekhana || 125 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; gopi balichhe vachana — the gopis say; aniye pathara — we bring stones; dekhi bandhaha ekhana — let us see, dam it now

125Hearing this, the gopis say:
'We will bring stones — let us see You dam it now!

মিছা গর্ব না করিহ শুনহ কানাই ।
পাথর ভাসয়ে জলে কভু শুনি নাই ॥ ১২৬ ॥

michā garba nā kariha śunaha kānāi |
pāthara bhāsaẏe jale kabhu śuni nāi || 126 ||

michha garva na kariha — do not boast in vain; shunaha kanai — listen, Kanai; pathara bhasaye jale — that stones float in water; kabhu shuni nai — we have never heard

126Do not boast in vain, listen, Kanai:
that stones float in water — we have never heard.'

ঠাকুর কহয়ে আন' এ গাছ পাথর ।
পাথরে বান্ধিব আমি এ সরোবর ॥ ১২৭ ॥

ṭhākura kahaẏe āna' e gācha pāthara |
pāthare bāndhiba āmi e sarobara || 127 ||

thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; ana e gachha pathara — bring these trees and stones; pathare bandhiba ami — I will dam with stones; e sarovara — this lake

127The Thakura says: 'Bring these trees and stones —
I will dam this lake with stones.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা তারা বহি' আনে ইটা ।
কাষ্ঠ খান-খান আনে পাথর গোটা-গোটা ॥ ১২৮ ॥

e bola śuniñā tārā bahi' āne iṭā |
kāṣṭha khāna-khāna āne pāthara goṭā-goṭā || 128 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; tara bahi ane ita — they carry bricks; kashtha khana-khana ane — bring pieces of wood; pathara gota-gota — whole stones

128Hearing this, they carry bricks,
bring pieces of wood and whole stones.

এক কূলে রহি' কৃষ্ণ বান্ধে সরোবর ।
এ কূলে ও কূলে সব লাগিল পাথর ॥ ১২৮+১ ॥

eka kūle rahi' kṛṣṇa bāndhe sarobara |
e kūle o kūle saba lāgila pāthara || 128+1 ||

eka kule rahi — standing on one bank; krishna bandhe sarovara — Krishna dams the lake; e kule o kule — from this bank to that; saba lagila pathara — stones were laid everywhere

128+1Standing on one bank, Krishna dams the lake:
from this bank to that, stones were laid everywhere5.

এ গাছ-পাথরে সরোবর গেল বান্ধা ।
ভাল ভাল বোলে গোপী মুচকি হাসে রাধা ॥ ১২৯ ॥

e gācha-pāthare sarobara gela bāndhā |
bhāla bhāla bole gopī mucaki hāse rādhā || 129 ||

e gachha-pathare — with these trees and stones; sarovara gela bandha — the lake was dammed; bhala bhala bole gopi — the gopis say "well done"; muchaki hase radha — Radha smiles faintly

129With these trees and stones the lake was dammed;
'Well done, well done!' say the gopis, and Radha smiles faintly.

রাধার কারণে সরোবরে হৈল সেতু ।
সেতুবন্ধ-সরোবর কহি এই হেতু ॥ ১৩০ ॥

rādhāra kāraṇe sarobare haila setu |
setubandha-sarobara kahi ei hetu || 130 ||

radhara karane — for Radha's sake; sarovare haila setu — a dam arose on the lake; setubandha-sarovara kahi — we call it the Setubandha lake; ei hetu — for this reason

130For Radha's sake a dam arose on the lake —
that is why it is called the Setubandha lake"6.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অন্তর উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৩১ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu antara ullāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 131 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu antara ullasa — the Lord rejoiced at heart; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

131Hearing this, the Lord rejoiced at heart;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa sings the glories of Gora.

Raga pathamanjari

সপ্তসমুদ্রক-কুণ্ড ইহার উত্তরে ।
দেবকীর সাত পুত্র মারিতে পাথরে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

saptasamudraka-kuṇḍa ihāra uttare |
debakīra sāta putra mārite pāthare || 132 ||

sapta-samudraka-kunda — the Saptasamudraka-kunda; ihara uttare — north of here; devakira sata putra — Devaki's seven sons; marite pathare — killing on a stone

132"North of here is the Saptasamudraka-kunda:
[here] Devaki's seven sons [were dashed] against a stone.

ইহার উত্তরে দেখ লিঙ্গ ভূতেশ্বর ।
দেখ সরস্বতী-কুণ্ড পুরীর উত্তর ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

ihāra uttare dekha liṅga bhūteśbara |
dekha sarasbatī-kuṇḍa purīra uttara || 133 ||

ihara uttare — north of here; dekha linga bhuteshvara — see the linga of Bhuteshvara; dekha sarasvati-kunda — see the Sarasvati-kunda; purira uttara — north of the city

133North of here, see, is the linga of Bhuteshvara;
see the Sarasvati-kunda to the north of the city.

এইখানে দেখ দশ-অশ্বমেধ-ঘাট ।
ইহার দক্ষিণে সোমতীর্থের এ বাট ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

eikhāne dekha daśa-aśbamedha-ghāṭa |
ihāra dakṣiṇe somatīrthera e bāṭa || 134 ||

eikhane dekha — here see; dasha-ashvamedha-ghata — the Dashashvamedha-ghata; ihara dakshine — south of here; soma-tirthera e bata — this way to the Soma-tirtha

134Here, see, is the Dashashvamedha-ghata;
south of here — the way to the Soma-tirtha.

কণ্ঠাভরণ-মজ্জন ইহার দক্ষিণে ।
নাগতীর্থ-ধারা বহে পাতাল-গমনে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

kaṇṭhābharaṇa-majjana ihāra dakṣiṇe |
nāgatīrtha-dhārā bahe pātāla-gamane || 135 ||

kanthabharana-majjana — the Kanthabharana-majjana; ihara dakshine — south of here; naga-tirtha-dhara bahe — the stream of the Naga-tirtha flows; patala-gamane — going down to Patala

135South of here is the Kanthabharana-majjana;
the stream of the Naga-tirtha flows, going down to Patala"7.

সংযমন-আদি কুণ্ড-ঘাটে গেলা তবে ।
পুরী প্রদক্ষিণ করে নিজ অনুভবে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

saṃyamana-ādi kuṇḍa-ghāṭe gelā tabe |
purī pradakṣiṇa kare nija anubhabe || 136 ||

samyamana-adi kunda-ghate — to Samyamana and other kundas and ghatas; gela tabe — then He went; puri pradakshina kare — walks round the city; nija anubhave — absorbed in His own feelings

136Then He went to Samyamana and the other kundas and ghatas
and walked round the city, absorbed in His own feelings.

এইমতে ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে দিন গেল ।
ভিক্ষা করিয়া প্রভু রজনী বঞ্চিল ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

eimate bhramite bhramite dina gela |
bhikṣā kariẏā prabhu rajanī bañcila || 137 ||

eimate — thus; bhramite bhramite — wandering and wandering; dina gela — the day passed; bhiksha kariya — having taken alms; prabhu rajani vanchila — the Lord spent the night

137Thus, wandering, the day passed;
having taken alms, the Lord spent the night.

উৎকণ্ঠায় আকুল দীঘল ভেল রাতি ।
পোহাইল পোহাইল পুছে হিয়ার আরতি ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

utkaṇṭhāẏa ākula dīghala bhela rāti |
pohāila pohāila puche hiẏāra ārati || 138 ||

utkanthaya akula — anxious with longing; dighala bhela rati — the night grew long; pohaila pohaila puchhe — "has it dawned? has it dawned?" He asks; hiyara arati — with the heart's pain

138Tormented by longing, the night seemed long to Him;
"Has it dawned? Has it dawned?" He asks, His heart aching.

রজনী প্রভাত হৈল হিয়ার উল্লাস ।
প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' বোলে আইস কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

rajanī prabhāta haila hiẏāra ullāsa |
prātaḥkriẏā kari' bole āisa kṛṣṇadāsa || 139 ||

rajani prabhata haila — the night turned to morning; hiyara ullasa — the heart's delight; pratah-kriya kari — performing the morning rites; bole aisa krishnadasa — He says: "Come, Krishnadasa"

139Night turned to morning — His heart rejoices;
having performed the morning rites, He says: "Come, Krishnadasa!"

কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে প্রভু শুনহ বচন ।
মথুরামণ্ডল-ভূমি একুইশ যোজন ॥ ১৪০ ॥

kṛṣṇadāsa bole prabhu śunaha bacana |
mathurāmaṇḍala-bhūmi ekuiśa yojana || 140 ||

krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; prabhu shunaha vachana — Lord, hear the word; mathura-mandala-bhumi — the land of the Mathura-mandala; ekuisha yojana — twenty-one yojanas

140Krishnadasa says: "Lord, hear my word:
the land of the Mathura-mandala is twenty-one yojanas;

দ্বাদশ বন হয় ছয় যোজন-ভিতর ।
যেখানে যে কৈল কৃষ্ণ দেখাব সকল ॥ ১৪১ ॥

dbādaśa bana haẏa chaẏa yojana-bhitara |
yekhāne ye kaila kṛṣṇa dekhāba sakala || 141 ||

dvadasha vana haya — the twelve forests lie; chhaya yojana-bhitara — within six yojanas; yekhane ye kaila krishna — what Krishna did where; dekhaba sakala — I will show all

141the twelve forests lie within six yojanas.
What Krishna did and where — I will show [You] everything.

নারদ-বচন কংস শুনে এইখানে ।
বসুদেব-দেবকীরে রাখে এইস্থানে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

nārada-bacana kaṃsa śune eikhāne |
basudeba-debakīre rākhe eisthāne || 142 ||

narada-vachana — Narada's words; kamsa shune eikhane — Kamsa hears here; vasudeva-devakire — Vasudeva and Devaki; rakhe eisthane — keeps in this place

142Here Kamsa heard the words of Narada,
here he kept Vasudeva and Devaki.

এইখানে হৈল কৃষ্ণ চতুর্ভুজ দেখি' ।
এথা পরিহার মাগে বসুদেব দেবকী ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

eikhāne haila kṛṣṇa caturbhuja dekhi' |
ethā parihāra māge basudeba debakī || 143 ||

eikhane haila krishna — here Krishna appeared; chaturbhuja dekhi — seeing [Him] four-armed; etha parihara mage — here beg for relief ([that He hide the form]); vasudeva devaki — Vasudeva and Devaki

143Here Krishna appeared; seeing Him four-armed,
Vasudeva and Devaki here beg [Him to hide that form].

এইখানে বসুদেব কৃষ্ণ লঞা কোলে ।
নিদ্রায় প্রহরিগণ পড়ি' গেল ভোলে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

eikhāne basudeba kṛṣṇa lañā kole |
nidrāẏa praharigaṇa paṛi' gela bhole || 144 ||

eikhane — from here; vasudeva krishna lanya kole — Vasudeva, taking Krishna in his arms; nidraya praharigana — the guards in sleep; padi gela bhole — lay senseless

144From here Vasudeva [went], taking Krishna in his arms,
while the guards, overcome with sleep, lay senseless.

ফণা-ছত্র ধরিয়া বাসুকি পাছে ধায় ।
যমুনাতে পার হৈতে শৃগালী আগে যায় ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

phaṇā-chatra dhariẏā bāsuki pāche dhāẏa |
yamunāte pāra haite śṛgālī āge yāẏa || 145 ||

phana-chhatra dhariya — holding his hoods as an umbrella; vasuki pachhe dhaya — Vasuki hurries behind; yamunate para haite — in crossing the Yamuna; shrigali age yaya — a she-jackal goes ahead

145Vasuki, spreading his hoods as an umbrella, hurries behind;
at the crossing of the Yamuna a she-jackal runs ahead.

এই মহাবনে নন্দঘোষের বসতি ।
নিদে প্রসবিলা কন্যা যশোদা পুণ্যবতী ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

ei mahābane nandaghoṣera basati |
nide prasabilā kanyā yaśodā puṇyabatī || 146 ||

ei mahavane — in this Mahavana; nanda-ghoshera vasati — the dwelling of Nanda Ghosha; nide prasavila kanya — in sleep bore a daughter; yashoda punyavati — the virtuous Yashoda

146Here is Mahavana, the dwelling of Nanda Ghosha;
here in her sleep the virtuous Yashoda bore a daughter.

নন্দ-ঘরে পুত্র থুইয়া কন্যারে আনিল ।
দেবকীর কন্যা বলি' কংসেরে ভাণ্ডিল ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

nanda-ghare putra thuiẏā kanyāre ānila |
debakīra kanyā bali' kaṃsere bhāṇḍila || 147 ||

nanda-ghare — in Nanda's house; putra thuiya — leaving the son; kanyare anila — brought the daughter; devakira kanya bali — calling her Devaki's daughter; kamsere bhandila — deceived Kamsa

147Leaving the son in Nanda's house, [Vasudeva] took the daughter,
and calling [her] Devaki's daughter they deceived Kamsa.

পাপিষ্ঠ সে কংসরাজ মারিতে কন্যারে ।
বিদ্যুৎ হইয়া তেঁহ গেল আকাশেরে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

pāpiṣṭha se kaṃsarāja mārite kanyāre |
bidyut haiẏā teṁha gela ākāśere || 148 ||

papishtha se kamsaraja — that wicked King Kamsa; marite kanyare — in trying to kill the girl; vidyut haiya — becoming lightning; tenha gela akashere — she went into the sky

148When the wicked King Kamsa tried to kill the girl,
she went up into the sky as lightning.

অপরাদ্ধ কংস স্তুতি করয়ে দোঁহারে ।
গগনে আকাশবাণী শুনে হেনকালে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

aparāddha kaṃsa stuti karaẏe doṁhāre |
gagane ākāśabāṇī śune henakāle || 149 ||

aparaddha kamsa — Kamsa, having done wrong; stuti karaye donhare — praises both; gagane akashavani — a voice from the sky; shune henakale — hears at this time

149Kamsa, having done wrong, praises both [Vasudeva and Devaki];
at that time he hears a voice from the sky.

শুনিঞা সে বাণী ধর্ম হিংসিতে লাগিল ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া নিজ মরণ জানিল ॥ ১৫০ ॥

śuniñā se bāṇī dharma hiṃsite lāgila |
niścaẏa kariẏā nija maraṇa jānila || 150 ||

shuninya se vani — hearing that voice; dharma himsite lagila — began to persecute the righteous; nishchaya kariya — with certainty; nija marana janila — knew his own death

150Hearing that voice, he began to persecute the righteous:
he knew for certain that death [awaited him].

মথুরা আইলা নন্দ পুত্রোৎসব করি' ।
বসুদেব বৈল রাখ শিশুরে আবরি' ॥ ১৫১ ॥

mathurā āilā nanda putrotsaba kari' |
basudeba baila rākha śiśure ābari' || 151 ||

mathura aila nanda — Nanda came to Mathura; putrotsava kari — having celebrated the son's festival; vasudeva baila — Vasudeva said; rakha shishure avari — guard the child, keeping Him hidden

151Having celebrated the festival for his son, Nanda came to Mathura;
Vasudeva said: 'Guard the child, keep Him hidden.'

সাতদিবসের কৃষ্ণ পূতনা বধিল ।
মাসেকের কালে শকট ভাঙ্গিয়া ফেলিল ॥ ১৫২ ॥

sātadibasera kṛṣṇa pūtanā badhila |
māsekera kāle śakaṭa bhāṅgiẏā phelila || 152 ||

satadivasera krishna — Krishna, seven days old; putana vadhila — killed Putana; masekera kale — at a month old; shakata bhangiya phelila — smashed the cart

152Seven days old, Krishna killed Putana;
at a month old He overturned and smashed the cart.

তৃণাবর্ত মারে কৃষ্ণ হঞা বিশ্বম্ভর ।
জৃম্ভায়ে মায়েরে বিশ্ব দেখাইল উদরে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

tṛṇābarta māre kṛṣṇa hañā biśbambhara |
jṛmbhāẏe māẏere biśba dekhāila udare || 153 ||

trinavarta mare krishna — Krishna kills Trinavarta; hanya vishvambhara — becoming the Bearer of the universe (heavy); jrimbhaye — yawning; mayere vishva dekhaila udare — showed His mother the universe in His belly

153Krishna kills Trinavarta, becoming heavy as the Bearer of the universe;
yawning, He showed His mother the universe in His belly.

ছয় মাসের পরে নামকরণ হইল ।
মৃত্তিকা-ভক্ষণে বিশ্বরূপ দেখাইল ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

chaẏa māsera pare nāmakaraṇa haila |
mṛttikā-bhakṣaṇe biśbarūpa dekhāila || 154 ||

chhaya masera pare — after six months; namakarana haila — came the name-giving; mrittika-bhakshane — when eating earth; vishvarupa dekhaila — He showed the universal form

154After six months came the name-giving;
when He ate earth, He showed the universal form.

মন্থনের দণ্ড ধরি' নাচিল এইখানে ।
দুগ্ধ উথলিতে এথা যশোদা-গমনে ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

manthanera daṇḍa dhari' nācila eikhāne |
dugdha uthalite ethā yaśodā-gamane || 155 ||

manthanera danda dhari — holding the churning rod; nachila eikhane — danced here; dugdha uthalite — when the milk boiled over; etha yashoda-gamane — here Yashoda went off

155Here He danced, holding on to the churning rod;
here Yashoda went off when the milk boiled over.

উদূখলে চড়ি' শিকার ভাণ্ড ছেদ করি' ।
ঊর্ধ্বমুখে নবনীত পান কৈল হরি ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

udūkhale caṛi' śikāra bhāṇḍa cheda kari' |
ūrdhbamukhe nabanīta pāna kaila hari || 156 ||

udukhale chadi — climbing on the mortar; shikara bhanda chheda kari — piercing the pot in the sling; urdhva-mukhe — face turned upward; navanita pana kaila hari — Hari ate butter

156Climbing on a mortar and piercing the pot in its sling,
Hari, His face turned upward, ate butter.

এইখানে চুরি করি' কৃষ্ণ খাইল ননী ।
উদূখলে বান্ধে লৈয়া যশোদা জননী ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

eikhāne curi kari' kṛṣṇa khāila nanī |
udūkhale bāndhe laiẏā yaśodā jananī || 157 ||

eikhane churi kari — here stealing; krishna khaila nani — Krishna ate butter; udukhale bandhe — binds to the mortar; laiya yashoda janani — mother Yashoda, taking Him

157Here Krishna stole and ate butter;
here mother Yashoda bound Him to the mortar.

যমল-অর্জুন-ভঙ্গ কৈল এইখানে ।
ধান্য দিয়া ফল খাইল দেব নারায়ণে ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

yamala-arjuna-bhaṅga kaila eikhāne |
dhānya diẏā phala khāila deba nārāẏaṇe || 158 ||

yamala-arjuna-bhanga kaila — broke the twin arjuna trees; eikhane — here; dhanya diya — giving grain; phala khaila deva narayane — the God Narayana ate fruit

158Here He broke the twin arjuna trees;
here, giving grain, the God Narayana ate fruit8.

মহাবন-দক্ষিণে দেখ গোকুল-নগর ।
শিশু-সঙ্গে বৎস রাখে এথা দামোদর ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

mahābana-dakṣiṇe dekha gokula-nagara |
śiśu-saṅge batsa rākhe ethā dāmodara || 159 ||

mahavana-dakshine — south of Mahavana; dekha gokula-nagara — see the town of Gokula; shishu-sange — with the boys; vatsa rakhe etha damodara — here Damodara herds calves

159South of Mahavana, see, is the town of Gokula:
here Damodara with the boys herded the calves.

হের দেখ গোপেশ্বর-মূর্তি মনোহর ।
সপ্তসমুদ্রক-কুণ্ড দেখহ সুন্দর ॥ ১৬০ ॥

hera dekha gopeśbara-mūrti manohara |
saptasamudraka-kuṇḍa dekhaha sundara || 160 ||

hera dekha — here, see; gopeshvara-murti manohara — the lovely Deity of Gopeshvara; sapta-samudraka-kunda — the Saptasamudraka-kunda; dekhaha sundara — see, beautiful

160Here, see, is the lovely Deity of Gopeshvara;
see how beautiful the Saptasamudraka-kunda is.

আয়ানের ঘর দেখ গ্রামের পশ্চিমে ।
সুন্দরগোপের ঘর তাহার দক্ষিণে ॥ ১৬১ ॥

āẏānera ghara dekha grāmera paścime |
sundaragopera ghara tāhāra dakṣiṇe || 161 ||

ayanera ghara — Ayana's house; dekha gramera pashchime — see, west of the village; sundara-gopera ghara — the house of the cowherd Sundara; tahara dakshine — south of it

161See — west of the village is Ayana's house;
south of it — the house of the cowherd Sundara.

উপনন্দের ঘর এই গ্রামের মধ্যখানে ।
পশ্চিমে দেখহ রাবণের তপোবনে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

upanandera ghara ei grāmera madhyakhāne |
paścime dekhaha rābaṇera tapobane || 162 ||

upanandera ghara ei — here is Upananda's house; gramera madhyakhane — in the middle of the village; pashchime dekhaha — to the west see; ravanera tapovane — Ravana's forest of austerity

162In the middle of the village — here is Upananda's house;
to the west, see, is Ravana's forest of austerity.

দেখহ দুর্বাসাশ্রম ইহার উত্তর ।
নিকটে দেখহ লোহবন মনোহর ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

dekhaha durbāsāśrama ihāra uttara |
nikaṭe dekhaha lohabana manohara || 163 ||

dekhaha durvasashrama — see the ashrama of Durvasa; ihara uttara — north of here; nikate dekhaha — near by see; lohavana manohara — the lovely Lohavana

163See — north of here is the ashrama of Durvasa;
near by, see, is the lovely Lohavana9.

অপরূপ কহিব এই হের বিল্ববনে ।
কৃষ্ণ কোলে করি' নন্দ আছিলা এখানে ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

aparūpa kahiba ei hera bilbabane |
kṛṣṇa kole kari' nanda āchilā ekhāne || 164 ||

aparupa kahiba — I will tell a marvel; ei hera bilvavana — here is Bilvavana; krishna kole kari — holding Krishna in his arms; nanda achhila ekhane — Nanda was here

164I will tell a marvel: here is Bilvavana —
here Nanda was, with Krishna in his arms.

রাধাকে দেখিয়া নন্দ কহিল উত্তর ।
কোলে করি' লেহ কৃষ্ণ থোও লঞা ঘর ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

rādhāke dekhiẏā nanda kahila uttara |
kole kari' leha kṛṣṇa thoo lañā ghara || 165 ||

radhake dekhiya — seeing Radha; nanda kahila uttara — Nanda said; kole kari leha krishna — take Krishna in your arms; thoo lanya ghara — carry Him home

165Seeing Radha, Nanda said to Her:
'Take Krishna in your arms, carry Him home.'

নন্দের আদেশে রাধা কৃষ্ণ কৈল কোলে ।
চুম্বন করয়ে বাল্য-আচরণ-ছলে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

nandera ādeśe rādhā kṛṣṇa kaila kole |
cumbana karaẏe bālya-ācaraṇa-chale || 166 ||

nandera adeshe — at Nanda's word; radha krishna kaila kole — Radha took Krishna in Her arms; chumbana karaye — kisses; balya-acharana-chhale — under the guise of childish ways

166At Nanda's word Radha took Krishna in Her arms;
[and He] kisses Her, as if in childish play.

কাজ নাহি বুঝে রাধা লঞা যায় পথে ।
গাঢ়-আলিঙ্গনে কুচ চিরে নখাঘাতে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

kāja nāhi bujhe rādhā lañā yāẏa pathe |
gāṛha-āliṅgane kuca cire nakhāghāte || 167 ||

kaja nahi bujhe radha — Radha does not understand the matter; lanya yaya pathe — carries Him along the road; gadha-alingane — in a tight embrace; kucha chire nakhaghate — marks the breast with His nails

167Not understanding the matter, Radha carries Him along the road;
in a tight embrace He leaves the marks of His nails on Her breast.

দেখিয়া চরিত্র রাধার বিস্ময় লাগিল ।
হিয়া উপজিল প্রেম বেকত না কৈল ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

dekhiẏā caritra rādhāra bismaẏa lāgila |
hiẏā upajila prema bekata nā kaila || 168 ||

dekhiya charitra — seeing [such] conduct; radhara vismaya lagila — Radha was amazed; hiya upajila prema — prema arose in Her heart; bekata na kaila — She did not show it

168Seeing such conduct, Radha was amazed;
prema arose in Her heart, but She did not show it10.

হের আর দেখ পুনঃ কৃষ্ণের চরিত ।
মরয়ে সকল শিশু তৃষ্ণায় পীড়িত ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

hera āra dekha punaḥ kṛṣṇera carita |
maraẏe sakala śiśu tṛṣṇāẏa pīṛita || 169 ||

hera ara dekha punah — here, see another; krishnera charita — deed of Krishna; maraye sakala shishu — all the boys are dying; trishnaya pidita — tormented by thirst

169Here, see, is another deed of Krishna:
all the boys, tormented by thirst, are dying —

পাঁচনী খনিল কুণ্ড দেখ বিদ্যমান ।
শুনিমাত্র গৌরচন্দ্র নাহি বাহ্যজ্ঞান ॥ ১৭০ ॥

pāṁcanī khanila kuṇḍa dekha bidyamāna |
śunimātra gauracandra nāhi bāhyajñāna || 170 ||

panchani khanila kunda — with a cowherd's stick He dug a pond; dekha vidyamana — see, there it is; shuni-matra — as soon as He heard; gaurachandra nahi bahya-jnana — Gaurachandra had no outer consciousness

170and He dug a pond with a cowherd's stick — there it is, see."
As soon as He heard this, Gaurachandra lost outer consciousness.

কথোক্ষণে গৌরচন্দ্রের হইল ত বাহ্য ।
প্রভু কহে কৃষ্ণদাস কি হইল কার্য ॥ ১৭১ ॥

kathokṣaṇe gauracandrera haila ta bāhya |
prabhu kahe kṛṣṇadāsa ki haila kārya || 171 ||

kathokshane — after a while; gaurachandrera haila ta bahya — Gaurachandra regained outer consciousness; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; krishnadasa ki haila karya — Krishnadasa, what happened

171After some time Gaurachandra came back to Himself;
the Lord says: "Krishnadasa, what happened next?"

এইখানে দেখ উপনন্দ-আদি যত ।
যুক্তি করিল সব গোয়ালা-সম্মত ॥ ১৭২ ॥

eikhāne dekha upananda-ādi yata |
yukti karila saba goẏālā-sammata || 172 ||

eikhane dekha — here see; upananda-adi yata — Upananda and all the others; yukti karila — held counsel; saba goyala-sammata — with all the cowherds agreeing

172"Here, see, Upananda and all the others
held counsel, and all the cowherds agreed:

অসহ্য এ রাজপীড়া নিত্যই সঙ্কট ।
রজনী-প্রভাতে সভে সাজাইল শকট ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

asahya e rājapīṛā nityai saṅkaṭa |
rajanī-prabhāte sabhe sājāila śakaṭa || 173 ||

asahya e rajapida — unbearable this oppression by the king; nityai sankata — danger every day; rajani-prabhate — at daybreak; sabhe sajaila shakata — all made ready the carts

173'Unbearable is this oppression of the king, every day is danger';
at daybreak they all made ready the carts.

গোপীগণ শকটে করিয়া গোপগণ ।
নিকট বসতি করিবারে বৃন্দাবন ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

gopīgaṇa śakaṭe kariẏā gopagaṇa |
nikaṭa basati karibāre bṛndābana || 174 ||

gopigana shakate kariya — seating the gopis in the carts; gopagana — the cowherds; nikata vasati karibare — to settle near by; vrindavana — in Vrindavana

174Seating the gopis in the carts, the cowherds
[set out] to settle near by, in Vrindavana.

হৈ হৈ রবে যায় গোধন চালাইয়া ।
পায়ে বাধা হাতে নড়ি মাথে পাগ দিয়া ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

hai hai rabe yāẏa godhana cālāiẏā |
pāẏe bādhā hāte naṛi māthe pāga diẏā || 175 ||

hai hai rave — with cries of "hey, hey"; yaya godhana chalaiya — they go driving the cows; paye badha — wraps on the feet; hate nadi — sticks in hand; mathe paga diya — turbans on the head

175With cries of 'hey, hey!' they go, driving the cows,
wraps on their feet, sticks in their hands, turbans on their heads.

শকটে চড়িয়া যায় কৃষ্ণ বলরাম ।
তার মুখ দেখি' গোপ সুখে চলি' যান ॥ ১৭৫+১ ॥

śakaṭe caṛiẏā yāẏa kṛṣṇa balarāma |
tāra mukha dekhi' gopa sukhe cali' yāna || 175+1 ||

shakate chadiya yaya — ride on a cart; krishna balarama — Krishna and Balarama; tara mukha dekhi — looking at Their faces; gopa sukhe chali yana — the cowherds go happily

175+1Krishna and Balarama ride on a cart;
looking at Their faces, the cowherds go happily11.

ভদ্র-ভাণ্ডীর-বনে ছিলা দুই মাস ।
আনন্দে গায়েন গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

bhadra-bhāṇḍīra-bane chilā dui māsa |
ānande gāẏena guṇa e locanadāsa || 176 ||

bhadra-bhandira-vane — in the Bhadra and Bhandira forests; chhila dui masa — they stayed two months; anande gayena guna — joyfully sings the glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

176Two months they lived in the Bhadra and Bhandira forests"12.
Joyfully this Lochana Dasa sings [His] glories.

তবে পার হৈলা সে নিকট বৃন্দাবনে ।
অর্ধচন্দ্রাকৃতি শকট রাখিল এইখানে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

tabe pāra hailā se nikaṭa bṛndābane |
ardhacandrākṛti śakaṭa rākhila eikhāne || 177 ||

tabe para haila — then they crossed; se nikata vrindavane — nearer, to Vrindavana; ardhachandrakriti — in a half-moon shape; shakata rakhila eikhane — set the carts here

177"Then they crossed over nearer, to Vrindavana;
here they set the carts in a half-moon.

কপিত্থ-গাছের মূলে বৎসক বধিল ।
পুচ্ছ-পদ ধরি' তারে তুলি' আছাড়িল ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

kapittha-gāchera mūle batsaka badhila |
puccha-pada dhari' tāre tuli' āchāṛila || 178 ||

kapittha-gachhera mule — at the root of a kapittha tree; vatsaka vadhila — killed Vatsaka (Vatsasura); puchchha-pada dhari — seizing tail and legs; tare tuli achhadila — lifted and dashed him down

178At the root of a kapittha tree He killed Vatsasura:
seizing him by the tail and legs, He lifted him and dashed him to the ground.

গিলি' উগারিল কৃষ্ণে এথা বকাসুর ।
দুই ঠোঁটে ধরি' চিরি' প্রাণ কৈল দূর ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

gili' ugārila kṛṣṇe ethā bakāsura |
dui ṭhoṁṭe dhari' ciri' prāṇa kaila dūra || 179 ||

gili ugarila krishne — swallowed and spat out Krishna; etha bakasura — here Bakasura; dui thonte dhari — seizing both beaks; chiri prana kaila dura — tearing him, took his life

179Here Bakasura swallowed Krishna and spat Him out;
seizing him by both beaks, He tore him apart and took his life.

এই গোঠে বিহরে বালক সব সঙ্গে ।
শিঙ্গা বেণু বেত্র হাথে নানাবিধ রঙ্গে ॥ ১৮০ ॥

ei goṭhe bihare bālaka saba saṅge |
śiṅgā beṇu betra hāthe nānābidha raṅge || 180 ||

ei gothe — in this pasture; vihare balaka saba sange — sports with all the boys; shinga venu vetra hathe — horns, flutes, sticks in hand; nanavidha range — in various sports

180In this pasture He plays with all the boys —
horns, flutes, sticks in hand, in various sports.

কেহো কোন জন্তু-ছলে সেই শব্দ করে ।
উড়িতে পক্ষের ছায়া চাহে ধরিবারে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

keho kona jantu-chale sei śabda kare |
uṛite pakṣera chāẏā cāhe dharibāre || 181 ||

keho kona jantu-chhale — someone, imitating some animal; sei shabda kare — makes its cry; udite pakshera chhaya — the shadow of a flying bird; chahe dharibare — wants to catch

181Some imitate the cry of some animal,
some want to catch the shadow of a flying bird."

এ বোল শুনিঞা গৌর বিহ্বল হিয়ায় ।
বালকের হেন সেই ইতস্তত ধায় ॥ ১৮২ ॥

e bola śuniñā gaura bihbala hiẏāẏa |
bālakera hena sei itastata dhāẏa || 182 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; gaura vihvala hiyaya — Gaura, distraught at heart; balakera hena — like a boy; sei itastata dhaya — runs here and there

182Hearing this, Gaura, distraught at heart,
runs here and there like a boy.

ময়ূরের শব্দ করে ধরয়ে পেখম ।
পুলকে পূরল অঙ্গ অরুণ নয়ন ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

maẏūrera śabda kare dharaẏe pekhama |
pulake pūrala aṅga aruṇa naẏana || 183 ||

mayurera shabda kare — cries like a peacock; dharaye pekhama — spreads a tail; pulake purala anga — the body full of thrill; aruna nayana — the eyes red

183He cries like a peacock, spreads [an imagined] tail;
His body is full of thrill, His eyes red.

ভাই ভাই বলি' ডাকে হৈ হৈ বোলে ।
শ্রীদাম সুদাম বলি' গাছ কৈল কোলে ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

bhāi bhāi bali' ḍāke hai hai bole |
śrīdāma sudāma bali' gācha kaila kole || 184 ||

bhai bhai bali dake — calls "brother, brother"; hai hai bole — shouts "hey, hey"; shridama sudama bali — crying "Shridama! Sudama!"; gachha kaila kole — embraced a tree

184"Brother, brother!" He calls, shouts: "Hey! Hey!";
"Shridama! Sudama!" He cries and embraces a tree.

সখ্য-ভাবে ব্যাকুল হইয়া গৌররায় ।
প্রেমায় আকুল হঞা চারিদিগে ধায় ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

sakhya-bhābe byākula haiẏā gaurarāẏa |
premāẏa ākula hañā cāridige dhāẏa || 185 ||

sakhya-bhave — in the bhava of friendship; vyakula haiya gauraraya — overwhelmed, Gaura Raya; premaya akula hanya — maddened with prema; charidige dhaya — runs in all directions

185Overwhelmed by the bhava of friendship, Gaura Raya,
maddened with prema, runs in all directions.

কালী ধবলী বলি' ডাকে ঘনে ঘন ।
কতি গেল ধেনুকাসুর মারিব এখন ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

kālī dhabalī bali' ḍāke ghane ghana |
kati gela dhenukāsura māriba ekhana || 186 ||

kali dhavali bali — crying "Kali! Dhavali!"; dake ghane ghana — calls again and again; kati gela dhenukasura — where has Dhenukasura gone; mariba ekhana — I will kill him now

186"Kali! Dhavali!" He calls again and again. —
"Where has Dhenukasura gone? I will kill him now!"

ইহা বলি' কান্দে বাহ্য নাহিক শরীরে ।
কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে এই সেই যদুবীরে ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

ihā bali' kānde bāhya nāhika śarīre |
kṛṣṇadāsa bole ei sei yadubīre || 187 ||

iha bali kande — saying this, He weeps; bahya nahika sharire — no outer awareness in the body; krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; ei sei yaduvire — this is He, the hero of the Yadus

187Saying this, He weeps; His body knows nothing outward.
Krishnadasa says: "This is He — the hero of the Yadus!"

সঙ্গের সঙ্গতিগণ তারাও তেমন ।
গোরা-মুখ নেহারয়ে নাহি সম্বেদন ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

saṅgera saṅgatigaṇa tārāo temana |
gorā-mukha nehāraẏe nāhi sambedana || 188 ||

sangera sangatigana — the companions with Him; tarao temana — they too likewise; gora-mukha neharaye — gaze at Gora's face; nahi sambedana — unaware

188And the companions with Him are in the same state:
they gaze at Gora's face, aware of nothing13.

কথোক্ষণে গৌরচন্দ্রের হইল ত বাহ্য ।
পুনরপি কৃষ্ণদাসে কহে কহ কার্য ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

kathokṣaṇe gauracandrera haila ta bāhya |
punarapi kṛṣṇadāse kahe kaha kārya || 189 ||

kathokshane — after a while; gaurachandrera haila ta bahya — Gaurachandra came back to Himself; punarapi krishnadase kahe — again says to Krishnadasa; kaha karya — tell what happened

189After some time Gaurachandra came back to Himself
and again says to Krishnadasa: "Tell Me what happened."

বকের কনিষ্ঠ সর্প নাম অঘাসুর ।
এইখানে কৃষ্ণ তার প্রাণ কৈল দূর ॥ ১৯০ ॥

bakera kaniṣṭha sarpa nāma aghāsura |
eikhāne kṛṣṇa tāra prāṇa kaila dūra || 190 ||

bakera kanishtha — Baka's younger brother; sarpa nama aghasura — a serpent named Aghasura; eikhane — here; krishna tara prana kaila dura — Krishna took his life

190"The serpent named Aghasura is Baka's younger brother;
here Krishna took his life.

এইখানে যমুনা ছিল নাহিক এখন ।
এইখানে হরিলা ব্রহ্মা বৎস-শিশুগণ ॥ ১৯১ ॥

eikhāne yamunā chila nāhika ekhana |
eikhāne harilā brahmā batsa-śiśugaṇa || 191 ||

eikhane yamuna chhila — here the Yamuna was; nahika ekhana — not now; eikhane harila brahma — here Brahma stole; vatsa-shishugana — the calves and boys

191Here the Yamuna used to be — now it is not;
here Brahma stole the calves and the boys.

বৎসরেক রাখিলা গোবর্ধনের ভিতরে ।
সেই বৎস-শিশু দেখি' ব্রহ্মা স্তব করে ॥ ১৯২ ॥

batsareka rākhilā gobardhanera bhitare |
sei batsa-śiśu dekhi' brahmā staba kare || 192 ||

vatsareka rakhila — for a year he kept; govardhanera bhitare — inside Govardhana; sei vatsa-shishu dekhi — seeing those same calves and boys; brahma stava kare — Brahma offers praise

192For a year he kept them in [a cave of] Govardhana;
seeing those same calves and boys, Brahma offered praise.

ধেনুক মারিয়া তাল খাইল বলরাম ।
যমুনাতে দেখ কালীদহ এই ঠাম ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

dhenuka māriẏā tāla khāila balarāma |
yamunāte dekha kālīdaha ei ṭhāma || 193 ||

dhenuka mariya — killing Dhenuka; tala khaila balarama — Balarama ate palm fruit; yamunate dekha — on the Yamuna see; kalidaha ei thama — this place, the Kaliya-daha

193[Here] Balarama killed Dhenuka and ate the palm fruits.
See — here on the Yamuna is the place Kaliya-daha.

কদম্বতরু আরোহণ কৈল এইখানে ।
ঝাঁপ দিয়া কৈল কালীনাগের দমনে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

kadambataru ārohaṇa kaila eikhāne |
jhāṁpa diẏā kaila kālīnāgera damane || 194 ||

kadamba-taru arohana kaila — climbed the kadamba tree; eikhane — here; jhanpa diya — leaping; kaila kali-nagera damane — subdued the serpent Kaliya

194Here He climbed the kadamba tree
and, leaping [into the water], subdued the serpent Kaliya.

শীতে আর্ত হঞা কৃষ্ণ এ ঘাটে উঠিলা ।
দ্বাদশ-আদিত্য তবে গগনে উদিলা ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

śīte ārta hañā kṛṣṇa e ghāṭe uṭhilā |
dbādaśa-āditya tabe gagane udilā || 195 ||

shite arta hanya — chilled; krishna e ghate uthila — Krishna came up on this ghata; dvadasha-aditya — the twelve suns (Adityas); tabe gagane udila — then rose in the sky

195Chilled through, Krishna came up on this ghata,
and then twelve suns rose in the sky.

দ্বাদশ-আদিত্য-ঘাট তেঞি বোলে লোকে ।
কালীয়দমন-মূর্তি দেখ পরতেখে ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

dbādaśa-āditya-ghāṭa teñi bole loke |
kālīẏadamana-mūrti dekha paratekhe || 196 ||

dvadasha-aditya-ghata — the ghata of the Twelve Adityas; tenyi bole loke — therefore people call it; kaliya-damana-murti — the Deity of Kaliya-damana; dekha paratekhe — see before you

196Therefore people call it the ghata of the Twelve Adityas;
see before you the Deity of Kaliya-damana [the Subduer of Kaliya].

এইখানে বালক বৎস পোড়ে দাবানলে ।
দাবানল পান করি' রাখিল সভারে ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

eikhāne bālaka batsa poṛe dābānale |
dābānala pāna kari' rākhila sabhāre || 197 ||

eikhane — here; balaka vatsa pode davanale — boys and calves were burning in the forest fire; davanala pana kari — drinking the fire; rakhila sabhare — saved them all

197Here the boys and calves were burning in the forest fire;
drinking up the fire, He saved them all.

শ্রীদামের কান্ধে কৃষ্ণ চড়িলা এখানে ।
প্রলম্ব হারিয়া কান্ধে করে বলরামে ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

śrīdāmera kāndhe kṛṣṇa caṛilā ekhāne |
pralamba hāriẏā kāndhe kare balarāme || 198 ||

shridamera kandhe — on Shridama's shoulders; krishna chadila ekhane — Krishna rode here; pralamba hariya — Pralamba, having lost; kandhe kare balarame — carried Balarama on his shoulders

198Here Krishna rode on Shridama's shoulders,
and Pralamba, having lost, carried Balarama on his shoulders.

অসুরের মায়া ব্যক্ত হৈল বলরামে ।
মস্তকে মারিল মুষ্টি ছাড়িল পরাণে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

asurera māẏā byakta haila balarāme |
mastake mārila muṣṭi chāṛila parāṇe || 199 ||

asurera maya — the asura's illusion; vyakta haila balarame — was revealed to Balarama; mastake marila mushti — He struck the head with His fist; chhadila parane — [he] gave up his life

199The asura's illusion was revealed to Balarama:
He struck him on the head with His fist, and he gave up his life.

ভাণ্ডীর-বনেতে অঘাসুরের মরণ ।
নিকটেতে দেখ গোসাঞি হের বৃন্দাবন ॥ ২০০ ॥

bhāṇḍīra-banete aghāsurera maraṇa |
nikaṭete dekha gosāñi hera bṛndābana || 200 ||

bhandira-vanete — in the Bhandira forest; aghasurera marana — the death of Aghasura; nikatete dekha — near by see; gosani hera vrindavana — Gosani, here is Vrindavana

200In the Bhandira forest — the death of Aghasura14.
Near by, see, Gosani, — here is Vrindavana.

ঈষীকা-মুঞ্জাটবী দেখ পরম-মোহন ।
এইখানে আচম্বিতে না দেখে গোধন ॥ ২০১ ॥

īṣīkā-muñjāṭabī dekha parama-mohana |
eikhāne ācambite nā dekhe godhana || 201 ||

ishika-munjatavi — the thickets of ishika and munja reeds; dekha parama-mohana — see, wondrously lovely; eikhane achambite — here suddenly; na dekhe godhana — they do not see the cows

201See — the thickets of ishika and munja reeds, wondrously lovely:
here suddenly [the boys] could not see the cows.

ধেনু না দেখিয়া সে বাঁশীতে দিল ফুঁক ।
ঊর্ধ্ব কাণ করি' ধেনু ধায় আইসে ঊর্ধ্বমুখ ॥ ২০২ ॥

dhenu nā dekhiẏā se bāṁśīte dila phuṁka |
ūrdhba kāṇa kari' dhenu dhāẏa āise ūrdhbamukha || 202 ||

dhenu na dekhiya — not seeing the cows; se banshite dila phunka — He blew on the flute; urdhva kana kari — pricking up their ears; dhenu dhaya aise urdhva-mukha — the cows come running, heads raised

202Not seeing the cows, He blew on the flute —
and the cows, pricking up their ears, come running, heads raised.

তৃণমুখে ধেনু ধায় বৎস স্তনমুখী ।
মুরলীর গানেতে মোহিত মৃগ পাখী ॥ ২০৩ ॥

tṛṇamukhe dhenu dhāẏa batsa stanamukhī |
muralīra gānete mohita mṛga pākhī || 203 ||

trina-mukhe dhenu dhaya — the cows run with grass in their mouths; vatsa stana-mukhi — the calves to the udders; muralira ganete — by the song of the flute; mohita mriga pakhi — beasts and birds enchanted

203The cows run with grass in their mouths, the calves to the udders;
beasts and birds are enchanted by the song of the flute.

পুনঃ দাবানলে ব্যগ্র ভেল শিশুগণ ।
দাবানল পান শিশু মুদিল নয়ন ॥ ২০৪ ॥

punaḥ dābānale byagra bhela śiśugaṇa |
dābānala pāna śiśu mudila naẏana || 204 ||

punah davanale — again by a forest fire; vyagra bhela shishugana — the boys were alarmed; davanala pana — the drinking of the fire; shishu mudila nayana — the boys closed their eyes

204Again the boys were alarmed by a forest fire;
[Krishna] drank up the fire, [while] the boys closed their eyes15.

এইমতে কৃষ্ণের বিহার স্থানে স্থানে ।
আনন্দে দেখয়ে গৌর কহয়ে লোচনে ॥ ২০৫ ॥

eimate kṛṣṇera bihāra sthāne sthāne |
ānande dekhaẏe gaura kahaẏe locane || 205 ||

eimate — thus; krishnera vihara — Krishna's pastimes; sthane sthane — place by place; anande dekhaye gaura — Gaura sees with joy; kahaye lochane — says Lochana

205Thus Krishna's pastimes, place by place,
Gaura sees with joy," says Lochana.

✦

Notes

  1. That is, though He is Krishna Himself, the Lord seems not to know His places and questions Krishnadasa.
  2. Vv. 88–95 — cf. Murari 4.04. Vasudeva carries the newborn Krishna from the prison to Gokula; the "place where He passed water" (mutra-sthana) is a shrine of Mathura.
  3. Uddhava is Krishna's friend and counsellor in Mathura; Krishna sent him to Vraja with a message to the gopis (Bhagavata 10.46–47). The Lord speaks as Krishna Himself, from memory.
  4. The Vishranti-ghata is the "ghata of rest", where Krishna rested after killing Kamsa; Gatashrama ("He whose weariness is gone") is the Deity of Vishnu at this ghata. Vv. 101–114 — cf. Murari 4.04: the houses of the washerman, the garland-maker, Kubja, Vasudeva and Ugrasena, the arena, the twelve ghatas, Kamsa's well.
  5. V. 128+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent from the 1903 edition.
  6. Vv. 116–130 — cf. Murari 4.05. Radha playfully teases Krishna: in the play of love the gopis deliberately refuse to acknowledge His greatness. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, Krishna is the original Bhagavan, and Rama is His manifestation; in answer to Her mockery He builds the dam. The Setubandha-sarovara is a lake near Kamana (Kamyavana).
  7. Vv. 132–136 — shrines of Mathura; cf. Murari 4.04. The Saptasamudraka-kunda is the "pond of the seven seas"; by tradition, at this place Kamsa killed Devaki's children. Patala is the underworld.
  8. Vv. 142–158 are a brief retelling of the Bhagavata (10.1–10.11): Narada's prophecy, Krishna's appearance in four-armed form, Vasudeva carries Him to Gokula, Yogamaya in the form of Yashoda's daughter goes up into the sky, the slaying of Putana, Shakata, Trinavarta, the universe in the Child's mouth, the stealing of butter, the Damodara-lila, the Yamala-arjuna trees, the fruit-seller. The she-jackal showing the ford is a Bengali tradition.
  9. Gopeshvara is Shiva, who by tradition took the form of a gopi to enter the rasa dance. Ayana (Abhimanyu) is by tradition Radha's husband; Gaudiya Vaishnavas teach that this marriage is only an appearance created by yogamaya for the sake of parakiya-rasa. "The cowherd Sundara" — so in A and C; the 1983 edition reads "Nanda-gopa". On "Ravana's forest of austerity" the 1903 edition gives in a footnote the reading: "where Ravana of Lanka performed austerities."
  10. Vv. 164–168 — a tradition (known from the Garga-samhita and the Brahma-vaivarta Purana): Nanda entrusts the infant Krishna to Radha in the Bhandira forest (in Lochana Dasa, in Bilvavana). Lochana Dasa tells it briefly and frankly. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching (Bhaktisiddhanta), the love of Radha and Krishna is wholly transcendental (aprakrita): Krishna is ever Radha's Beloved, and His pastimes in the form of a child are not to be measured by worldly standards; these lilas must not be understood after the pattern of worldly relations.
  11. V. 175+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent from the 1903 edition.
  12. Vv. 159–176 — cf. Bhagavata 10.11 (the move to Vrindavana because of the troubles in Gokula). Bhadra and Bhandira are two of the twelve forests.
  13. The Lord, in the mood of a cowherd friend (sakhya-bhava), calls Shridama and Sudama, and also the cows. In the 1983 edition the cows are Dhavali and Shangali (cf. en/23). "This is He — the hero of the Yadus": Krishnadasa recognizes in the Lord Krishna Himself.
  14. Vv. 190–200 follow the Bhagavata (10.11–10.20): Aghasura, the stealing of the calves by Brahma, Dhenuka, Kaliya, the forest fire, Pralamba. Pralamba was killed by Balarama in the Bhandira forest; "the death of Aghasura" in v. 200 (so in A and B) is apparently a slip for Pralamba.
  15. Vv. 201–204 follow the Bhagavata (10.19): the cows strayed into the reed thickets, and a forest fire broke out; Krishna told the boys to close their eyes and swallowed the fire.
